About

I'm a Product Designer with 6+ years designing enterprise and B2B SaaS products across web and native mobile. My work lives at the intersection of complex systems, real user needs, and technical constraints.

I specialise in enterprise UX and design system governance: the kind of work where consistency, accessibility, and scalability matter as much as visual quality. I've owned design system architecture across multiple platforms.

I work closely with product managers and engineering teams to translate complex processes into clear, measurable experiences. I care about the why behind every decision, not just the output.

Based in Lisbon  ·  Open to senior product design roles across Europe and remote
